native.ltm_edition: Actual reviewed Release18 source set versus independently registered other release. No NR/NB-IoT fallback.
native.ltm_category: Actual matched DL/UL category pair; M2 also advertises M1 capabilities, not an arbitrary mixed pair.
native.ltm_role: Actual UE versus serving eNodeB; UE output-power/error requirements do not describe a base station.
native.ltm_direction: Actual scheduled radio direction, not a generic symmetric bus clock.
native.ltm_duplex: Actual FDD/TDD serving band. HD-FDD typeB is a UE mode within FDD.
native.ltm_ue_duplex: Actual half/full FDD or TDD UE capability; actual scheduler must observe HD typeB guards.
native.ltm_ce_mode: Actual coverage enhancement ModeA/B, independently supported and network selected.
native.ltm_rrc_state: Actual RRC context; non-repeated unicast connected mode qualifies optional DL64QAM.
native.ltm_service: Actual unicast versus independently qualified multicast/control channel.
native.ltm_modulation: Actual PUSCH/PDSCH selected modulation; UL64/256QAM not supported by M1/M2.
native.ltm_power_class: Actual commissioned UE power class; nominal maximum is not current output.
native.ltm_carrier20_block: Actual UL20MHz bandwidth footnote interval for bands28/71.
native.ltm_cyclic_prefix: Actual selected normal versus extended PHY CP.
native.ltm_grant_profile: Actual channel/RNTI and network wideband configuration:5MHz config is a grant ceiling, not literal serving carrier bandwidth. An independently registered grant has its own source.
native.ltm_security_profile: Actual access-stratum/NAS and separately registered application protection.
native.ltm_revision: Actual full device/network release and compatible TS36.306/101/211/213/321/331 and NAS profiles.
native.ltm_registered_source: Actual independent schema/codec for another release/category/service/modulation/power profile.
native.ltm_device_source: Actual certified modem/firmware/category/CE/duplex/band and optional capabilities.
native.ltm_binding_source: Actual canonical UE/eNodeB/cell and separately registered application/backhaul transport paths.
native.ltm_network_source: Actual serving-cell radio configuration and network admission, not an automatic LTE-M band.
native.ltm_regulatory_source: Actual jurisdiction, licensed deployment band and radio approval; norm is not permission.
native.ltm_physical_source: Actual RF link budget/interference/sensitivity/antenna/temperature/frequency and device evidence.
native.ltm_scheduler_source: Actual grants/allocated PRBs/MCS/TBS/repetitions/HD guards/TDD layout under complete shared-cell workload.
native.ltm_mac_rlc_source: Actual TS36.321/322 and network HARQ/RLC retransmission, queues and latency configuration.
native.ltm_rrc_nas_source: Actual TS36.331/24.301/24.008 state/timer/PSM/eDRX paging and negotiation profile.
native.ltm_application_source: Actual endpoint application codec and per-message byte count, independently selected IP/non-IP path.
native.ltm_security_source: Actual independently protected subscription/key references, access-stratum/NAS and application security.
native.ltm_capacity_source: Actual complete radio/core/backhaul/server capacity evidence; category peak is not net throughput.
native.ltm_acceptance_source: Actual functional E2E/freshness/safety acceptance, distinct from HARQ/RLC acknowledgement.
native.ltm_ue_id: Actual commissioned UE reference; never invent IMSI/IMEI/subscriber credentials.
native.ltm_cell_id: Actual network assigned serving cell, not a default eNodeB or CAN identifier.
native.ltm_subscription_key_ref: Actual protected subscription credential reference; never default credentials.
native.ltm_carrier_aggregation_source: Actual band66 DL2180..2200MHz qualified carrier-aggregation/device/network proof.
native.ltm_band74_capability_source: Actual compliance with band11 and band21 requirements when band74 is supported.
native.ltm_power_profile_source: Actual non-CA/non-UL-MIMO class/MPR/A-MPR/P-MPR/tolerance; table6.2.2E lacks a band66 row.
native.ltm_spectral_source: Actual occupied bandwidth/SEM/ACLR/spurious/blocking receiver and qualified test-condition evidence.
native.ltm_frequency_error_source: Actual error compared to received eNodeB carrier over a0.5ms observation, not an oscillator catalog tolerance.
native.ltm_retuning_source: Actual ce-RetuningSymbols/range/direction transitions and TS36.211 guards; not a universal2us delay.
native.ltm_airtime_source: Actual coded/repeated scheduled airtime including control/reference/guard resources, not appbytes/peakbits.
native.ltm_tdd_pattern: Actual ten subframe D/S/U pattern from configured UL/DL assignment.
native.ltm_tdd_special_source: Actual DwPTS/GP/UpPTS pattern and CP-qualified special subframe configuration.
native.ltm_psm_timer_encoding: Actual negotiated NAS T3412/T3324 units/value/deactivation encoding; no fabricated lifetime.
native.ltm_edrx_timer_encoding: Actual negotiated LTE-M eDRX/paging window encoding, distinct from NB-IoT tables.
native.ltm_harq_source: Actual applicable TS36.213 process counts/repetition/feedback/RTT per CE/duplex capability.
native.ltm_band: Actual eligible E-UTRA band, not any LTE/NR/NB-IoT band.
native.ltm_carrier_bandwidth_mhz: Actual serving E-UTRA carrier bandwidth; M1 can use narrowband resources within a20MHz carrier.
native.ltm_carrier_prbs: Actual total serving-carrier PRBs, not allocated UE PRBs.
native.ltm_ue_max_bandwidth_mhz: Normative selected category/band maximum capability bandwidth, not serving carrier or installed device evidence.
native.ltm_allocated_prbs: Actual scheduled PUSCH/PDSCH PRBs, not total carrier PRBs; M2wideband max24,3MHz carrier ULmax13 including odd central PRB versus DLmax12.
native.ltm_allocated_bandwidth_mhz: Actual scheduled bandwidth qualified by CE/direction/category and serving carrier.
native.ltm_carrier_mhz: Actual direction-qualified radio frequency; band66 CA footnote remains separate.
native.ltm_dl_tb_limit_bits: Normative category DLtransport block limit per TTI, including optional M1 feature; not actual message length or rate.
native.ltm_dl_soft_buffer_bits: Normative category soft channel bit capability; not free application queue size.
native.ltm_ul_tb_limit_bits: Normative category ULtransport block limit per TTI, including optional M1 feature; not actual granted TBS.
native.ltm_layer2_capability_bytes: Normative total L2buffer capability, not queue allocation or available hardware memory.
native.ltm_dl_spatial_layers: Normative max1 DLspatiallayer for M1/M2, not NR MIMO.
native.ltm_actual_tb_bits: Actual scheduler-selected transport block, distinct from application bytes/segmentation.
native.ltm_repetitions: Actual selected PUSCH/PDSCH/MPDCCH repetition count from independent channel/CE/grant profile.
native.ltm_scheduled_bound_ms: Actual complete local scheduling/airtime upper bound; no zero-delay assumption.
native.ltm_functional_bound_ms: Actual functional end-to-end deadline, independent of radio ACK/grant/nominal peak.
native.ltm_frame_ms: Normative frame duration10ms, not application cycle.
native.ltm_subframe_ms: Normative subframe duration1ms, not assumed repetition-free application TTI.
native.ltm_slot_ms: Normative15kHz-SCS slot duration0.5ms, not an NR scalable slot.
native.ltm_scs_khz: Normative LTE-M resource spacing15kHz, not NB-IoT3.75kHz.
native.ltm_prb_subcarriers: Normative12subcarriers per regular PRB, distinct from optional sub-PRB UL allocation.
native.ltm_prb_bandwidth_khz: Normative180kHz resource block width; not occupied spectrum, channel BW or byte throughput.
native.ltm_ul_symbols_per_slot: Normative7normalCP/6extendedCP ULsymbols per slot, includes channel-dependent overhead.
native.ltm_narrowband_prbs: Normative regular LTE-M narrowband six PRBs, not every serving carrier size.
native.ltm_wideband_prbs: Actual up-to-four DLnarrowbands per wideband; fewer when carrier has fewer than four narrowbands.
native.ltm_tdd_assignment: Actual UL/DL subframe assignment0..6, not a generic duty percentage.
native.ltm_tdd_switch_ms: Normative selected TDDswitchpoint periodicity5/10ms, not functional latency.
native.ltm_hd_guard_before_ms: Normative typeB no-DL subframe immediately before UL, not an available payload window.
native.ltm_hd_guard_after_ms: Normative typeB no-DL subframe immediately after UL.
native.ltm_nominal_max_power_dbm: Nominal selected UE class maximum excluding tolerance/MPR, not current output power.
native.ltm_output_power_dbm: Actual measured controlled transmit power; actual profile controls MPR/tolerance, not max-class default.
native.ltm_continuous_ul_ms: Actual continuous uplink duration;64ms selects HD-FDD frequency-error requirements.
native.ltm_frequency_error_abs_ppm: Actual absolute frequency error observed over0.5ms; bound is not a measured default.
native.ltm_ce_a_supported: Actual declared mandatory CE ModeA support, not inferred proof from category choice.
native.ltm_ce_b_supported: Actual optional CE ModeB support; implies CE ModeA.
native.ltm_ul_max_tbs_r14: Actual optional ce-PUSCH-NB-MaxTBS-r14 M1 ModeA1.4MHz2984-bit feature.
native.ltm_dl_max_tbs_r17: Actual optional ce-PDSCH-MaxTBS-r17 M1 ModeA1.4MHz1736-bit feature.
native.ltm_dl_64qam_r15: Actual optional connected non-repeated unicast CE ModeA DL64QAM support.
native.ltm_wideband_r14: Actual ce-PDSCH-PUSCH-MaxBandwidth-r14 capability, not applicableM1 and mandatoryM2.
native.ltm_subprb_r15: Actual optional ce-PUSCH-SubPRB-Allocation-r15 and scheduler support, not regular12-tone allocation.
native.ltm_psm_enabled: Actual negotiated PSM; enabling it does not select timers or guarantee immediate reachability.
native.ltm_edrx_enabled: Actual negotiated extended DRX; LTE-M paging differs from NB-IoT.
native.ltm_capacity_confirmed: Actual complete approval, never True from one band/bandwidth or published peak rate.
native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded application length, not PHY transport-block bits, MAC/RLC/PDCP segmented length, serving-carrier capacity or a universal8/1500byte default. Application/transport codec needs independent source.

scope: Each declared field reviewed independently for meaning/applicability, scalar type/unit/bounds, exact source/revision and conditional proposals. Retained NIS scenario fields are explicit application requirements, not radio standards.

All37eligible Release18 LTE-M bands reviewed separately against RF5.5E and visually checked band/channel tables; FDD/TDD, allowed serving-carrier bandwidths, carrier PRB mappings and UL/DL frequency intervals remain distinct from category bandwidth. Band106 supports only1.4/3MHz; M2max=min(5,maxBand).

CatM1/M2 DL/UL TBS, soft bits, L2 capability buffers, optional1736/2984 features and matched category pair reviewed from TS36.306; capability maxima are not actual device support, grant, application payload or throughput. Optional ModeA capability does not prohibit smaller ModeB operation.
ModeB UL remains1.4MHz/sixPRBs; optional DL64QAM requires connected non-repeated unicast ModeA and capability. No UL64/256QAM or NB-IoT3.75kHz/NR numerology fallback.

Frame10ms/subframe1ms/15kHzslot0.5ms/regular12subcarrier PRB180kHz and CP-qualified ULsymbols checked. DLwideband uses available one/two/four narrowbands rather than unconditional24PRBs. TDD assignments and special-subframe proof distinct from HD-FDD typeB guards.
